_doc: BuildReasonSeg Advisor RC1 default model package. Every asset records its source, SHA256 and bytes; the decoder was selected by Task 7I validation (NOT by the Task 7J final test).
build_task: Task 8A (local delivery foundation and package contract)

research_baseline.research_tasks: Task 7I formal train/validation, Task 7J final frozen-architecture test

framework.pytorch: 2.13.0+cu132 (research environment; delivery environment describes the same versions)

architecture.decoder: D-B1 (deterministic field-weighted visual prototype over frozen SAM2 tokens)

decoder_selection.selected_by_detail: highest oracle-reference full-val (936 records) mIoU among the three D-B1 seeds: 0.387688 (20261003) vs 0.382651 (20261002) vs 0.379934 (20261001)

assets.note: sha256 recorded from the copied file at build time; the delivery copy is authoritative for RC1

assets.parsed_from: text-only Qwen3-VL-2B + ProgramHead (20 canonical program ids)

checkpoint_selection_provenance.selection_split: Task 7I formal validation (936 oracle-reference v0.2 L3 val records)
checkpoint_selection_provenance.selection_metric: mean target mIoU over all 936 records

input_domain.supported: RGB optical remote sensing imagery (512x512 tiles or larger images via outer orchestration)

known_limitations: Reference selection is the dominant practical bottleneck (Task 7F/7H); the frozen U-C1 deterministic largest selector stays in the chain because no learned replacement passed its adoption gate (Task 7G).

Practical predicted-reference advantage of D-B1 over Z-B3 is small: +0.006535 on Task 7I validation and +0.002863 on the Task 7J final test, while the oracle-reference advantage is +0.050982 / +0.054816.
Free-form natural-language robustness is NOT solved: Task 7C canonical accuracy 1.0 but fixed24 5/24, compact 0/8, stress 0.6667. RC1 must present a controlled-language/canonical interface.
D-B1 does not universally improve the counterfactual pair pass rate: its own-cross margin is larger but its pass rate is lower than Z-B3 under both references.
nearest-only L2 is experimental/limited and is NOT a formal RC1 capability.
Unseen-city / cross-domain generalization is not established; the native split demonstrates raster/scene separation only.
No performance PASS/FAIL verdict exists for the Task 7J final test; it is a measurement stage.
Unrestricted natural language, a solved reference stage, an untouched test split and any novelty/first claim must not be stated.
